audits.ince_year_integrity: A July 2023 third-party environmental search report exposes older Pollution Inventory values for NP3101SV including CO2 41,376,000 kg, but it predates target year and is not used as 2024 evidence. No adjacent-year or older-value substitution is allowed.
audits.public_index_policy: Fresh exact searches for NP3101SV, WP3738DE and JP3132RV combined with 2024 Pollution Inventory/CO2 returned no explicit target-year annual Air mass rows. This preserves fail-closed state rather than implying zero.
audits.identity_policy: EA permits and Companies House close the operator/company/permit chains independently. Later corporate administration or renaming is not backfilled into 2024 unless target-year evidence supports it.
audits.permit_limit_policy: Permit emission limits, BAT conditions, monitoring requirements and concentration values are never converted into annual mass candidates.
audits.direct_raw_policy: Official 2024 PI binary rows remain unavailable in this runtime after Part111's bounded transport attempt; direct PI row count remains zero.
audits.zero_policy: Below-threshold, missing, older-year and unindexed values remain no-data, never zero.
